title: Scalar-normalized finite coefficient unit comparison
statement: Fix a prime $\ell$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$, and $m\in\mathbf N$. Put $A=\mathcal O_E/\varpi_E^{m+1}$ using [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. Let $X$ be a scheme and use its small pro-etale site [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site]. Use the intrinsic derived tensor, its recorded closed monoidal structure and K-flat tensor models [def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom], and K-flatness [def-pc-kflat-complex]. Let $A_X[0]$ be the coefficient module sheaf in degree zero and let $\mathbf1$ be the recorded intrinsic tensor unit. An isomorphism $e:\mathbf1\cong A_X[0]$ is scalar-normalized if, for every K-flat complex $P$, the coefficient unit complex is K-flat and there is a chain map $\rho:\operatorname{Tot}(P\otimes A_X[0])\to P$ sending each local pure tensor $x\otimes a$ to $ax$, such that the K-flat tensor-model comparison followed by $1\otimes e^{-1}$ and the recorded right unitor equals $Q(\rho)$. There is exactly one scalar-normalized $e$; define the finite coefficient-unit comparison to be that unique isomorphism.
